# dsh-plugin-verified-search
English · 繁體中文 · 简体中文
**A DeepSeek Harness plugin that looks up current sources and shows which evidence it kept and which
questions it could not answer.**
The plugin replaces the `web_search` tool an agent inherits with bounded workflows. Each workflow ma
kes visible which sources were in scope, which evidence was kept, how JSON values were selected, and
which gaps remain. It is the installable companion to deepseek-harness Discussion #332, and it also
mounts the time context discussed in Discussion #344.
The plugin checks that the workflow and the structured sources meet stated conditions. It does **not
** certify that a publisher is telling the truth, and it cannot guarantee that an upstream search in
a publisher is telling the truth, and it cannot guarantee that an upstream search index is current.

Last green `main` snapshot on 2026-08-16; 250 tests and the 42-case frozen offline corpus passed |

Moving `main` | `main` | Unreleased development | Do not install unpinned; behavior and generated a
rtifacts may change between commits |
> **No external party has independently validated this plugin.** The evidence in this repository com
es from internal deterministic tests, CI, package-reproducibility checks, and conformance runs by th
e maintainer. None of it is presented as third-party review.
## Prerequisites
- You need DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` and Cordis `4.0.1`. The official `0.1.2-alpha.1` tree was r
eviewed at the source level and showed no breaking change to any surface this plugin uses. The exact

peer contract will move to it once it is published to npm.
- You need Node.js `22.19.x` or `24.x`.
- A `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` must be available through the Harness credential service or the launch enviro

nment.
- You need a preset that can already search. The plugin does not give search capability to th

e shipped `minimal` preset.
- The plugin can share one `web` profile with the `dsh-web` ecosystem bu
ndle (`@linxin666/dsh-web-all`) and `dsh-deepseek-girl-pet`. The combined five-layer patch was compo
sed with the official `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include` and produced 169 entries with no duplicat
e ids, no missing rows and no warnings. No ecosystem package registers `web_search` or mounts `time-

context`, and no HTTP routes collide.
- CI covers Ubuntu and Windows. macOS is not currently part of
the support contract.
Read the compatibility contract before you change the Harness, Cordis, Node, or package-manager vers
the compatibility contract before you change the Harness, Cordis, Node, or package-manager version.

## Minimal quickstart
Ask a search-capable agent a narrow question with an absolute date, for example:
> Find DeepSeek's current flagship API model as of 2026-08-14. Use only `api-docs.deepseek.com`. If
the retained sources do not contain an answer-bearing excerpt, report the claim as unresolved instea
d of filling it from memory.
The matching model-facing `verified_search` arguments are:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You should see the following behavior:

- The native provider allowlist is sent upstream.
- The structured sources that come back are filter

ed again locally, by exact hostname or subdomain.
- URLs that carry credentials, and URL parts that
are sensitive or used for tracking, are rejected or removed before results become visible in the ses

sion.
- A title or URL without a retained citation excerpt is not promoted to verified evidence.
- A
n evidence gap stays visible and is not filled with an older or memorized answer.
If you also need independent sources for comparison, run a separate query without a domain restricti
on. The allowlist is a condition on the hostnames of the structured sources that come back. It is no
t a network-egress or privacy boundary.
## Trust and security boundary
The plugin can enforce that the structured sources it returns, after local filtering, match an expli
cit hostname allowlist. The experimental full-page reader goes further. It retrieves only bounded pu
blic HTTPS targets and applies DNS and IP validation, pinned transport, redirect checks, a check for
supported text and JSON media types, charset validation, and byte and time limits.
It does **not** prove that:

- the provider's private candidate pool or generated prose used only allowed domains;
- the provider

did not retrieve another page or follow a redirect outside the allowlist;
- the upstream index cont

ains the newest page or ranks time correctly;
- a retained phrase entails the requested claim or han

an API response is authentic, complete, unpaginated, correctly ordered, or factually correct;
- tex
t from a public page is safe to follow as instructions.
Search queries are stored durably as Harness session data. Never put secrets, signed URLs, or privat
e data in a query. SECURITY.md explains private reporting and the full threat boundary.
## Security reporting
To report a suspected credential leak, allowlist bypass, or unsafe page-fetch path, use this reposit
ory's private GitHub security-advisory form. Do not paste API keys, signed URLs, private queries, pr
ivate excerpts, or raw session logs into a public issue.
